name: Mariam Saliba
title: Senior media professional and broadcast trainer
bio_short: Senior media professional with more than 18 years' experience in broadcast journalism. Currently producer at Abu Dhabi TV. Former Al Arabiya, Sky News Arabia and Alhurra TV. Trains executives and spokespeople in communication and media skills in Arabic and English.
bio: Mariam is a senior media professional with more than 18 years' experience in presenting, writing, reporting and producing news and business stories. She currently works as a producer for Abu Dhabi TV. Her career includes senior roles at Al Arabiya in Dubai, Sky News Arabia in Abu Dhabi, Alhurra TV in Washington DC and LBCI in Lebanon.  Mariam has covered major international events including the World Economic Forum in Davos, IMF and World Bank meetings, G20 summits, OPEC meetings, Expo Milano, Expo Kazakhstan and Hannover Messe. She has interviewed ministers, CEOs and senior executives across the world. She holds a Master's degree in international affairs and diplomacy from Notre Dame University and a Bachelor's degree in political sciences from the Lebanese University.  At ISOC, Mariam delivers communication, media training and interview coaching programmes for executives and spokespeople in Arabic and English. Her experience covering major international economic and business events gives her a deep understanding of the media environment that senior executives face when representing their organisations on the global stage. She knows what journalists are looking for and can prepare spokespeople specifically for high-profile media contexts. Mariam is based in Dubai and trains in Arabic and English.
